_about: Anonymised decision-time requests for HVH2D-NLH-005 (two-day Human vs Horse study, 2026-11-12): ten All-In-Or-Fold hold'em tournament decisions facing a lone all-in, as the production journal recorded them. The five bigBlind cases carry rngBefore, the generator state the journal recorded for that decision. Seats, stacks, cards and public action only; every user, table, cache and tournament id is replaced by a placeholder, names are 'seat' and avatars are removed.

queenNineSuited._about: Q9s in the small blind, 7.4 big blinds effective against a 14.75 big blind all-in from seat 8; the big blind is sitting out, so the small blind closes the action. Recorded action: fold.

pocketFours._about: 44 in seat 5 with 3 big blinds against a 6 big blind all-in from seat 9; both blinds are still to act behind. Recorded action: fold.

kingThreeOffsuit._about: K3o in seat 4 with 5.5 big blinds against the same all-in (same hand as pocketFours, one seat earlier); three players still to act behind. Recorded action: fold.

pocketFives._about: 55 in the small blind, 7.6 big blinds effective against a 12.25 big blind all-in from seat 8; the big blind is still to act behind. Recorded action: fold.

aceSevenSuited._about: A7s on the button facing a 15 big blind all-in from seat 4, covered by the hero; both blinds are still to act behind. Recorded action: fold.

bigBlindKingQueenOffsuit._about: KQo in the big blind, 12 big blinds effective against a 12 big blind all-in from seat 2; everyone else has folded. Recorded action: fold.

bigBlindQueenTenSuited._about: QTs in the big blind, 7.3 big blinds effective against a 10 big blind all-in from seat 4; everyone else has folded. Recorded action: fold.

bigBlindAceFiveOffsuit._about: A5o in the big blind facing a 4.4 big blind all-in from seat 9, covered by the hero; everyone else has folded. Recorded action: fold.

bigBlindAceThreeSuited._about: A3s in the big blind, 11.1 big blinds effective against a 13.8 big blind all-in from seat 8; everyone else has folded. Recorded action: fold.

bigBlindAceFiveSuited._about: A5s in the big blind facing a 6 big blind all-in from seat 9, covered by the hero; everyone else has folded (the same hand as pocketFours and kingThreeOffsuit, after they folded). Recorded action: fold.
